summary: Implemented SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py (SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path) and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The 41 tests in the new module and test/test_path.py pass under the shared venv. Nothing committed. Not verified: mypy and black are not installed in the venv, so type-check and formatting were checked by reading only (line lengths within 88). Judgment call: added an isinstance(Node) guard (via an object-typed local) because None would otherwise act as a graph wildcard, which the spec's "no separate check" note overlooks; mypy warn_unreachable behavior on that guard is unconfirmed.
